subject.title: fix: keep LINE group allowlists scoped [AI]

question: Should LINE enforce group sender access only through per-group `allowFrom` or `groupAllowFrom`, accepting that upgrades may block senders previously inherited from DM `allowFrom`?
rationale: The patch restores the documented security boundary but intentionally removes a shipped fallback that some existing configurations may rely upon.

options.title: Enforce strict group scoping
options.body: Approve the fail-closed boundary and require upgrade guidance plus live LINE proof before merge.

options.title: Stage a compatibility transition
options.body: Preserve the fallback temporarily with a warning and explicit removal plan if immediate blocking is too disruptive.

recommendation.title: Enforce strict group scoping
recommendation.body: Approve the fail-closed boundary and require upgrade guidance plus live LINE proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the canonical LINE authorization-boundary synthesis and are best positioned to confirm whether the remaining fallback was intentional.
